title: Shooter (capstone)
summary: The capstone — four composed machines at scale: an orchestrator with waves + a boss fight, a player, parameterized enemies, and a three-phase HSM boss whose phase clusters change on HP thresholds.
teaches: Everything composed at scale · parameterized Enemy instances · three-phase Boss HSM (HP-threshold phase changes) · orchestrator with waves + push$/pop$ pause
controls: Arrows/WASD move · hold SPACE fire · P pause · SPACE start · R restart

machines.title: Shooter — the orchestrator
machines.blurb: Attract waits, then start advances into Playing (the wave grinder); when the last wave clears the orchestrator transitions to BossFight; on the boss going down it lands in Victory, and on the player running out of lives it falls into GameOver. Pause is push$/pop$ from either Playing or BossFight so resume returns to the exact phase you were in.

machines.title: Player
machines.blurb: Alive (steerable, can shoot), Exploding (death animation), Invulnerable (the brief grace window after respawn), Dead (out of lives). The orchestrator routes hits and respawns; the Player machine decides what's valid in each mode.

machines.title: Boss — three-phase HSM at HP thresholds
machines.blurb: Three cluster parents — PhaseOne, PhaseTwo, PhaseThree — each containing an Idle and an attack child (P1Firing / P2Spread / P3Spray) running on a tick toggle. The `hit` handler lives on each phase parent: when the boss's HP crosses a threshold inside a phase, the cluster transition leaves the whole phase and enters the next one's Idle child. After PhaseThree the boss exits to Dying then Gone.

machines.title: Enemy — parameterized instances
machines.blurb: Spawning (the entry sweep, no fire yet), Active (in the rally — can fire on its own fire_rate), Dying (the brief explosion), Gone (eligible for cleanup). Each enemy instance is parameterized at construction (kind, hp, fire_rate, points), and many run concurrently; the diagram tracks the first one in the orchestrator's enemy list.
